definitions.explanation: A person who works in agriculture, especially a small-scale or traditional farmer.

examples.japanese: {農民|のうみん}⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早朝|そうちょう}→早朝：03109_souchou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: The farmers work from early morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{農民|のうみん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しかった→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
examples.english: The life of farmers in the Edo period was harsh.

examples.japanese: {農民|のうみん}⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}こった→起こる：01910_okoru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{農民|のうみん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{主|おも}に→主に：01607_omoni⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: The farmers in this region mainly grow rice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{干|かん}ばつ→干ばつ：05122_kanbatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}き→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、{農民|のうみん}⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧な⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The drought continued and the farmers' lives were seriously affected.

notes:
SIMILAR/RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧ (farm household; farmer - more common in modern usage)
- {農業者|のうぎょうしゃ} (agricultural worker - formal)
- {百姓|ひゃくしょう} (farmer - traditional term, can sound dated or rude)
- {小作人|こさくにん} (tenant farmer - historical)

ETYMOLOGY:
{農民|のうみん} often appears in historical contexts, such as discussions of the feudal class system where farmers were the second class ({士農工商|しのうこうしょう}).

MODERN USAGE:
⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧ is more commonly used today to refer to farming families or farmers in neutral contexts.
